==About me==

I first picked up ''[[The Eye of the World]]'' way back in '99, when I was 15 or 16. It was on special at Target and I liked the picture on the front! I enjoyed the prologue but was disappointed by the first few chapters, and set the book aside for something more exciting.

It was only a couple of months later, when I was at home alone and bored out of my brain, that I remembered I had a book I hadn't finished reading yet. I decided to push through it, hoping something exciting would happen. And then the [[Trollocs]] attacked [[Emond's Field]] on [[Winternight]], and I was hooked. I remember being so surprised that [[Tam]] lived! I thought I had the whole series figured out, that the rest of the books would be about [[Rand]] avenging his father's death. But I was wrong, and I think that helped to keep me interested, because I wanted to find out what other surprises [[Robert Jordan]] had in store.

I enjoy writing fanfics based in ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' world, I may add some links at a later date. I was also big into WoT role-playing 5-10 years ago, but I haven't RPed in years now. In fact, my avatar was drawn for me by a friend from one of those role-playing sites. It's based on an RP character I created in '00, Daea, a novice who ended up becoming [[Sitter]] and [[First Chair]] for the [[Brown Ajah]] (though this was before the title First Chair existed, how annoying).

If I were an [[Aes Sedai]] I'd be a Brown, for sure. But not a dusty, distracted one tucked away in a forgotten corner of the [[White Tower Library|Library]]. I'd be off discovering artifacts and treasure, like Indiana Jones. No whip though, I'm not that exciting!

My favourite characters are [[Faile]], [[Perrin]] and [[Pevara]], and I have a love-hate relationship with [[Egwene]]. I liked her a lot in the earlier books, but then she became so irritating! But after the [[Egwene#Attack_of_the_Seanchan|attack on the White Tower]], I like her again.

I've compiled quite a bit of info over the years about Aes Sedai and the [[White Tower]], and am always up for discussing anything to do with [[Tar Valon]]. :)
